title: A directory without a project
goal: Dana works in a directory that is no project of hers. Recall reads only the global namespace and her private namespace. A proposal is refused.
place: Dana's notes directory `~/notes`. It has no Git remote of a project, and her config names no such directory.

learned: With no project, recall reads only `/shared/` and `/actor/<actorId>/`.
A proposal without a project is refused with `project_none`.
A project outside the person's config is refused with `not_member`.
`AGENTCORE_PROJECT` cannot add a project that the config does not hold.
cannot: A prompt cannot change the project of a recall.
A model can name a project in a propose call, but only a project of the person, and the write still needs the confirmation.
A propose call without a `projectId` cannot write in a directory outside every configured project.
notVerified: Where Pi shows the line about `AGENTCORE_PROJECT`.
The refusal `not_member` and the variable `AGENTCORE_PROJECT` in a live session.
